tokyo_yakuzen_hinabe_shinbasei.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the shop's own official page (shinbasei-shibuya.owst.jp) and the HotPepper listing it maintains, food updated 2025-10-03 and drinks 2025-08-08, checked 2026-08-20. This is a Sichuan medicinal hotpot: you pick a broth (or two, in a split pot), then order raw ingredients plate by plate and cook them yourself. Broth prices are per person; everything else is per plate. There is a 2h free-flow drink add-on at ¥1,500 (tax excl.), and course sets from ¥2,100 food-only / ¥3,800 with free-flow. Under-20s are not admitted, even accompanied.
